title: Ribbon-cutting ceremony held for first facility for US Space Command at Redstone Arsenal
text:
A ribbon-cutting ceremony was held for the first facility for the U.S. Space Command at Redstone Arsenal.
Top Brass cut the ribbon on the first facility for the Command’s new headquarters on Wednesday at Redstone Arsenal. General Stephen Whiting spearheaded Wednesday’s festivities, aligning the move with the country’s 250th anniversary.
“For two and a half centuries, we have been explorers, innovators, and guardians of freedom,” Whiting said. “From the first pioneers who pushed westward to the engineers who carried us to the moon, our history is defined by breaking barriers. Today, the men and women of U.S. Space Command carry that legacy forward, joining the leaders and innovators of Rocket City to shape the future of the space domain.
